result.reason: The clause confirms Customer ownership of Type I Materials and Customer Data, but it does not reach either playbook position. Type II Materials may include materials created during the Services, allowing IBM to own Customer-specific deliverables rather than only pre-existing IP or generic tools. Customer’s Type II licence is limited to use and distribution within its Enterprise and does not include modification or sublicensing rights, so it is insufficient under both the preferred embedded-IP licence and the fallback. There is also no operative assignment by IBM. The new copyright-notice requirement is not needed to implement the playbook, although the remaining edits generally preserve unrelated commercial intent. The margin comment does not cure these operative deficiencies.
